name: One-Two-Three-Four!

description.content: While idle, use <Activate Ability> to perform, empowering all Survivors within [16m] for up to [15s]. While performing, your Aura is revealed to other Survivors. Empowered Survivors are [20%] more likely to receive basic Skill Checks while healing or repairing.
If you complete the performance, the effect ends after [90s].

quote: "We are loud! We are heavy! WE ARE AXEKICK!" -Vee Boonyasak
